title: Social Preview Drift Guard URL audits
description: One audit item per inspected URL.

normalizedUrl.description: Normalized public HTTP(S) URL when parsing succeeded.

verdict.description: PASS means no material issue was detected; RISK means actionable preview weaknesses were observed; FAIL means a decisive broken/contradictory state was observed; INCONCLUSIVE means there was not enough transport evidence to judge.

riskScore.description: Deterministic severity score. Null when the audit is inconclusive.

measurementStatus.description: Whether the target was successfully observed or the measurement was inconclusive.

measurementReason.description: Reason measurement could not produce a PASS/RISK/FAIL verdict, when applicable.

issues.description: Machine-readable detected issues with code, severity, message, and optional details.

rulesetVersion.description: Version of the deterministic audit ruleset.

scope.description: Explicit capability/limitation envelope for interpreting the result.

checkedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the audit completed.

overview.title: Preview health overview
overview.description: Compact decision view for CI, publishing QA, and automated workflows.
